recognize_zh: 單核球（monocyte）、帶狀/分節中性球、骨髓細胞（myelocyte）與有核紅血球混雜成團，呈現單核球增多加左移與有核紅血球，符合 JMML 的周邊血液表現。
features: Clustered nucleated cells in a myelomonocytic mixture
Monocytes and promonocyte-like cells with folded nuclei and gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm
Left-shifted granulocytes including myelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils, some with hypolobated nuclei
Several nucleated red blood cells with dense round nuclei
Occasional large platelet; red cells without marked poikilocytosis
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a cluster of nucleated cells composed of monocytes, immature granulocytes (myelocytes and metamyelocytes), bands and segmented neutrophils, together with several nucleated red blood cells. Monocytes have folded nuclei and gray-blue, finely vacuolated cytoplasm; occasional neutrophils appear hypolobated. No significant population of blasts is evident in this field. In a young child, findings are consistent with juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia, pending correlation with the absolute monocyte count, hemoglobin F and RAS-pathway genetics.

ddx.vs: CML shows a marked granulocytic leukocytosis with myelocyte and neutrophil peaks and basophilia rather than prominent monocytosis, and is BCR::ABL1 positive.

ddx.dx: Reactive monocytosis/leukoerythroblastosis (e.g., viral infection such as CMV/EBV)
ddx.vs: Reactive states lack sustained monocytosis >1x10^9/L with clonal RAS-pathway mutations and usually resolve; morphology alone may not separate them.
CMML shows similar morphology but occurs in older adults; JMML is defined by pediatric age and RAS-pathway alterations.
